set.body: Institutionalize the observed performance rule: a public map-scale path is not certified until it has an independent oracle and a dimensional performance gate. Acceptance: inventory every public execution path and classify interactive, map-scale, or explicitly experimental; record dimensional regime, warm-up, repetitions, hardware, runtime, peak RSS, and storage; run parity before timing; add scheduled/manual triggers for expensive gates; fail CI when a certified path loses its gate metadata; and ensure ungated paths are named as unqualified rather than inheriting another path's performance claim.
set.title: Require a map-scale admission gate for every public execution path
